summary: Honeywell International Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the spin-off of its Aerospace Technologies business into a new publicly traded company, Honeywell Aerospace Inc. The board approved a record date of June 15, 2026, with the pro-rata distribution expected effective June 29, 2026. Eligible holders will receive one share of Honeywell Aerospace for every two Honeywell shares held. Cash will be paid for fractional shares. The spin-off is structured as a tax-free distribution to shareholders. The expected close is June 2026. Watch for IRS ruling on tax-free treatment and any shareholder litigation.
